basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Calgary International Entrance Scholarship
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all undergraduate faculties: Schulich School of Engineering, Faculty of Science (Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Haskayne School of Business, Cumming School of Medicine (Health Sciences), Arts, and Architecture.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~2 to 4 major prestigious entrance scholarships awarded annually (renewable for 4 years)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition; awarded to the highest-achieving international matriculants (typically 1 awardee every 1-2 years from South Asia)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 years (renewable annually up to CAD $80,000 total)

nationality_requirements: International students who are not Canadian citizens or Permanent Residents
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Entering first year of undergraduate studies directly from high school.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed higher secondary education (FSc Pre-Engineering/Pre-Medical or A-Levels) with exceptional academic distinction.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 95.0% average across academic high school subjects (or minimum 3 A*s in A-Levels / 950+ out of 1100 in FSc).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced high school mathematics, physics, and chemistry for engineering and computer science programs.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating high school senior entering Fall term.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Must be entering university directly from high school without having completed prior university coursework.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Extracurricular leadership, scientific olympiads, and community service evaluated.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in all bands), TOEFL iBT 86, or Duolingo English Test (DET) 115.

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite international academic and leadership high school graduates.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have attended any post-secondary institution.

tuition_fee.details: CAD $20,000 per year for 4 years (CAD $80,000 total), directly credited against international undergraduate tuition fees (~CAD $27,000 to $35,000/year).

admission_application_fee.details: University of Calgary undergraduate application fee (CAD $145) paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: Covered from scholarship credit or personal funds; on-campus residence guaranteed for first-year students.

monthly_stipend.details: Scholarship is applied directly to student tuition fee account; surplus can be refunded for living expenses.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit application fee (CAD $150) and biometrics (CAD $85) paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: Alberta Health Care Insurance Plan (AHCIP) provides free basic health coverage for international students with study permits of 12+ months.

food_allowance.details: Self-funded or paid from scholarship surplus / family support.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: University library, laboratory facilities, and software provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Undergraduate research awards (PURE Awards - CAD $6,000 to $7,500 for summer research) available in years 2-4.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Calgary Transit U-Pass included in university mandatory fees (unlimited city bus and CTrain).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: University of Calgary (Calgary, Alberta, Canada).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #198 QS World University Rankings 2025; Top 10 in Canada; #1 in Canada for startup creation.
available_majors: Software Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical & Petroleum Engineering, Health Sciences, Business (Haskayne), Physics, Biochemistry
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: High school completion with minimum 95% average in required academic subjects (Math, Physics, Chemistry, English).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Software Engineering and Computer Science require competitive grade averages above 95%.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply for undergraduate admission by December 1, and complete the High School Awards application before December 15.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Calgary Student Center (myUofC) Awards Application
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Submit undergraduate admission application on ucalgary.ca by December 1. Step 2: Log into myUofC portal and complete High School Awards application by December 15.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Apply for undergraduate admission on ucalgary.ca portal before December 1.
2. Pay the CAD $145 application fee and receive UCID number.
3. Log into myUofC Student Centre and navigate to 'Apply for Awards'.
4. Complete High School Entrance Awards application before December 15.
5. Upload personal statements, leadership activities list, and reference letters.
6. Central awards committee reviews academic transcripts and extracurricular essays.
8. Accept offer, pay deposit, and apply for Canadian Study Permit.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Sequential: University admission application first, followed by High School Awards portal application using UCID.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 1 school counselor or teacher referee.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Essays detailing extracurricular leadership, contributions to school and community, and future aspirations at UCalgary.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Extracurricular activity profile completed within the myUofC application form.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: SAT/ACT not required for Canadian universities; English language test required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official board/Cambridge transcripts submitted by high school counselor or examination board directly.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online through myUofC Student Centre portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: High School Transcripts (Matric & FSc / O & A Levels)
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official transcripts and predicted grades showing 95%+ or A* grades
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC / British Council predicted grades

required_documents_checklist.specification: Answers to essay prompts detailing community engagement and leadership
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight school head boy/girl, debate, or science competitions

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential letter from school principal or guidance counselor

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official IELTS/TOEFL or Duolingo score report

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Early December 1 admission deadline and December 15 awards deadline are strictly enforced.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (High school academic GPA, rigorous STEM subject grades)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: University of Calgary Undergraduate Awards Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Transcript grade screening (top 1-2% percentile) -> Extracurricular essay scoring -> Final committee award ranking.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~2 to 4 International Entrance Scholarships per year
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~0.05% (One of the most competitive undergraduate awards in Canada)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 96.0%+ high school average (or 3 to 4 A* grades in A-Levels)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top student in their high school or province, international Olympiad medalist (IMO, IPhO, IOI), or national debate champion with extensive community service.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Top graduates from elite schools in Pakistan (Aitchison, Beaconhouse, Roots, KGS, Cadet Colleges).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: India, Pakistan, China, Nigeria, United Kingdom, United States.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: University application fee is strictly CAD $145 paid inside official UCalgary portal. No extra fee for the scholarship.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Calgary awards are decided solely by the university committee; no external agent has quota access.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Tuition balance after CAD $20,000 scholarship (~CAD $7,000 to $15,000/year out of pocket depending on engineering/CS program)
Campus residence and meal plan (~CAD $11,000 to $14,000/year)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: CAD $20,000 covers all expenses. (Truth: International tuition is ~CAD $30,000–$38,000/year; students must fund the remaining tuition and living costs).
MYTH: You can apply late in spring. (Truth: The awards deadline is strictly December 15; missing it means zero entrance scholarship consideration).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Agents claim all students with 90% get CAD $20,000; in reality, only 2-4 students globally win this major entrance award.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum GPA of 3.20 out of 4.00 over a minimum of 24.00 units (8 courses) in the preceding fall and winter terms to renew for years 2, 3, and 4.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual GPA evaluation at end of winter term (May).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 20-24 hours per week off campus and unlimited hours on campus under Canadian study permit.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; international graduates from UCalgary qualify for Canada's 3-year Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: If GPA drops below 3.20 or course load drops below 24 units, renewal is revoked permanently.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted within UCalgary provided student maintains full-time registration and required GPA.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum 4 academic years (8 terms); no extension for year 5.
